excellent: All fixed commitments and departure limits are preserved with explicit contingencies
adequate: Most constraints are preserved with minor ambiguity
revise: One or more hard constraints are moved ignored or overlapped

excellent: Activities are grouped logically with minimal unnecessary travel
adequate: Clustering is mostly sensible with one avoidable crossing
revise: The schedule assigns times before considering geography

excellent: Travel setup meals notes and daily recovery blocks are realistic
adequate: Most buffers exist but one day is too dense
revise: Back-to-back scheduling or excessive technical workload makes the plan fragile

excellent: Every live fact is flagged and checks are staged by timing
adequate: Most live facts are identified but checks are incomplete
revise: Exercise estimates are presented as verified facts

excellent: Arrival delay and site loss produce practical bounded alternatives
adequate: Contingencies exist but create secondary conflicts

excellent: Budget is transparent and the calendar export is complete and readable
adequate: Budget and export are usable with minor errors
revise: Costs are hidden exceeded without escalation or export fields are unusable
